annotations.title: Get image set status and images

description: Returns each image’s status (queued, generating, done, failed), its text check (passed, retried, differs, not-checked; checking while it runs), small previews of finished images, and download links valid for 15 minutes. Free. Call again until done is true. A shot can get one extra version by itself: a free retry when the text on the first one did not match.
